Yes, they are distinct simulations. The Contact Center Call Simulation (id 4189) is a 15‑minute remote test that measures an agent’s ability to resolve customer concerns on a call by consulting standard process documents, making it ideal when you need to assess procedural adherence under time pressure. The Customer Service Phone Simulation (id 3933) is a slightly longer 20‑minute remote exercise aimed at entry‑level contact‑center roles, focusing on general phone‑based customer service skills, so it’s useful when you want a broader view of call handling aptitude.
Perfect — new simulation for volume, old solution for finalists. Confirmed.
